info.title: Haya.Tool
info.description: CLI tool for generating collaboration, responsibilities, and component documentation as markdown and mermaid C4 diagrams.

commands.name: config
commands.description:
Get and set configuration (env vars,
.haya/config.json, global config)

options.name: --local
options.description:
Read or write the nearest .haya/config.json (set and
unset default to it; for a new file, the current
directory)

options.name: --global
options.description:
Read or write the global file in the OS config
directory (haya/config.json)

options.name: --show-origin
options.description:
With list: show which file or environment variable
each value comes from
